outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a representative H&E image and spatial transcriptomic plots from a single tissue section with no quantification, averaging, or statistical comparison; replication reporting is not applicable.

replicate_statements: The staining was repeated with lung sections from different mice (n = 2–3, biological replicates).
outputs.explanation: Panel B presents representative RNAscope images (no summary statistics or error bars). The caption reports both the number (n = 2–3) and type (biological replicates, different mice) of replicates, which is sufficient for representative image data even though the minimum n is 2.

replicate_statements: LUSC patient tumors (n = 500) relative to LUAD tumors (n = 512)
outputs.explanation: Panel C shows a scatter plot with median and 95% CI and a statistical test (Welch's t test) comparing TCGA patient tumor samples. Both the number (n = 500/512) and type (patient tumors) of replicates are reported, well above the minimum threshold.

replicate_statements: The experiment was repeated two times to confirm the observations.
outputs.explanation: Panel D is a bar graph (mean ± SD) with a statistical test (one-way ANOVA with Dunnett's test). The legend reports both the number (n = 3) and type (technical replicates) of replicates, and the minimum n exceeds 2.
